decision: Escalate as test-infrastructure gate, not Specialist implementation. The three independently replaced output files have no transaction boundary; archive load-then-append is a separate unverified concurrency risk. Freeze corrected no-network two-writer contract; baseline RED must demonstrate Writer B reaches its write while A is paused, post-fix GREEN must permit B to wait behind A and verify both returned and persisted generations. Do not mistake historical workflow runs or bounded done-task PASS for independent A proof. No Gemini task until structured JSON reliability proven.

blocker.next: Provision authorized disposable checkout at exact public SHA; run baseline RED then targeted python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests; record SHA, exit codes and logs. Separately test archive idempotence.
